Class WatchlistPriceUpdateService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.WatchlistPriceUpdateService
@Service public class WatchlistPriceUpdateService extends Object
Reserves a watchlist price update in a short transaction, releasing its row lock before external providers or asynchronous report queries are awaited. The reservation survives a later report failure, so retries respect the configured update interval.

READ COMMITTED applies only to this reservation. With MariaDB 11.8 snapshot isolation, a REPEATABLE READ ownership query followed by a competing update can otherwise fail with "Record has changed since last read". The conditional UPDATE still serializes competing reservations through its row lock.

  • Method Details

    • claimUpdate

      @Transactional(propagation=REQUIRES_NEW, isolation=READ_COMMITTED) public WatchlistPriceUpdateService.PriceUpdateClaim claimUpdate(Integer idWatchlist, Integer idTenant, LocalDateTime now, LocalDateTime threshold)
      Checks ownership and atomically reserves an update if the previous attempt is stale. Called through the Spring proxy so that the reservation commits independently of the report transaction.
      Parameters:
      idWatchlist - the watchlist to update
      idTenant - the requesting tenant
      now - the timestamp of this attempt
      threshold - only timestamps strictly before this value (or null) permit a new attempt
      Returns:
      the update decision and the stored timestamp, independent of the caller's database snapshot
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if the watchlist does not belong to the tenant or no longer exists
